final_presentation_rule: Call of Duty Zombies MapMod-style full weapon packages; Quake/NZ:P weapon models are forbidden as final presentation.

policy.animation_contract: Core weapon operation requires idle/fire/reload/equip. ADS transitions use physical runtime alignment unless a real authored clip exists; optional authored roles are used when present.
